records.Report_Details:
右乳上象限后部等密度结节及左乳上象限后部不规则略高密度影，BI-RADS 3类考虑，请结合临床，建议进一步检查明确。


注：
A．如果出现临床可疑肿块，阴性报告不应延误活检。有些癌症不能通过影像学检查发现。
B．假阳性报告平均为6-10%。

An isodense nodule in the posterior aspect of the upper quadrant of the right breast and an irregular, slightly hyperdense area in the posterior aspect of the upper quadrant of the left breast, considered BI-RADS 3; clinical correlation is advised, and further examination is recommended for clarification.

Note:
A. If a clinically suspicious mass is present, a negative report should not delay biopsy. Some cancers may not be detected by imaging studies.
B. The average false-positive rate is 6-10%.
